hypotheses.title: Tilt-Angle Derivative & Analytic-Signal Depth-Ratio Structural Continuity Across Volcanic/Playa Cover (TRG-M)
layers: rtp, tmi, tmi_vg, TMI_up150, iso_grav_anom, iso_grav_anom_hg, iso_grav_anom_vg
hypotheses.signature: Miller-Singh (1994) tilt angle T = arctan(VDR / (THDR + eps)), Verduzco horizontal tilt gradient |grad T| (depth-invariant contact edge), and upward-continuation attenuation ratio |grad TMI_up150| / (|grad tmi| + eps) distinguishing deep crustal fault steps (> 1 km) from thin (< 100 m) volcanic flow-lobe margins.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: Ordinary horizontal gradients fade as 1 / z^2 over deep sub-alluvial faults in Carson Sink, Black Rock Desert, and Gabbs Valley while exploding over 20 m surface basaltic flow edges; tilt-angle equalization normalizes amplitude across depth.
hypotheses.confounders: Shallow basaltic lava-flow rims and cultural pipeline/rail anomalies.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: No script in src/gems27 computes arctan(VDR/THDR), |grad T|, or upward-continuation attenuation ratios.
hypotheses.data_gate: 17/17 hash-pinned raster bands in data_cache/; zero external downloads.

hypotheses.title: 2D Tensorial Basement-Depth Graben Asymmetry & Geodetic Shear-to-Dilatation Partitioning (BDSS-A)

hypotheses.signature: Cross-strike asymmetric pairing between steep footwall basement-depth drops (|grad depth_to_base_surf|) and down-dropped hanging-wall MT smectite clay-cap conductivity anomalies (cond_surf) 300-900 m basinward in the steepest basement-descent direction, modulated by kinematic transtension ratio geod_shearrate / (|geod_dilaterate| + geod_shearrate).
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: Blind intrabasin half-graben master faults and accommodation-zone stepovers produce asymmetric hanging-wall alteration caps offset 300-900 m basinward of the basement step with zero surface scarp.
hypotheses.confounders: Conductive saline playa evaporites in flat basin centers (zero |grad depth_to_base_surf|).
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: H28-3 tested co-located dilaterate x cond_surf (-0.0026); H30-1 used 1D axis shifts; 2D vector-advected hanging-wall clay-cap pairing along grad(depth_to_base_surf) is untried.

hypotheses.signature: Closed-loop fractional-programming optimization (Charnes-Cooper / Dinkelbach iteration on u_i - lambda* * (alpha + (1 - alpha*rho - beta)*u_i)) jointly solving optimal total dot budget N* and local ridge-axial spacing d_min(x) in [2.2, 3.0] px without hard-fixing N = 37,654.
